answer: In a market where agents trade survey data about a mesa, a knoll, or a river delta, governance votes are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, with no bonus for opening an account. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives exactly the same voting power as staking them through one agent. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock period.
